name: Biomass to Brilliance: Engineering a Greener Future
org: NC State Paper Science and Engineering
what_you_do: A week-long camp. You make green energy, biofuels, bioplastics and gels from plants. You also learn how paper is recycled.
who_can_apply: Rising high school juniors and seniors.
deadline_text: 2026 session was June 21-26, 2026 with a March 2026 deadline. 2027 dates not posted yet.
how_to_apply: The program page links to an interest form and to a program website. It does not list application steps.
